name: Ruwan Jayasekara
title: Executive Chef & Keeper of the Clay
biography: Raised between the cinnamon groves of Matale and his grandmother's soot-blackened kitchen, Ruwan has spent two decades reviving the slow clay-pot traditions of Sri Lanka's southern coast.
He trained under master curry-makers in Batticaloa and Jaffna before leading Praneetha's hearth, where every dish is braised over wild cinnamon timber in unglazed Kelani river terracotta.

dishes.imageAlt: Sri Lankan chicken curry served with flatbread
dishes.label: HEIRLOOM RECIPE #07
dishes.name: Hearth Chicken Curry & Godamba
dishes.description: Village chicken simmered in roasted curry powder, served with flaky godamba roti.

dishes.label: FOREST HARVEST
dishes.name: Overnight Polos Ambula
dishes.description: Baby jackfruit braised until its fibers dissolve over dying coals.

dishes.label: HERITAGE GRAIN
dishes.name: Ember-Toasted Heritage Rice
dishes.description: Suduru samba rice tossed with cashews, carrot, and curry leaves in a clay wok.

quote: The clay remembers every curry it has held. My work is only to listen to the fire and let the pot finish the story.

name: Arjun Thiruchelvam
title: Chef de Cuisine & Keeper of Jaffna Flavour
biography: Arjun brings the bold, layered flavours of Jaffna to Praneetha's kitchen. His cooking honours family recipes and the fragrant, carefully balanced spice blends he grew up with.
At the hearth, he pairs those traditions with seasonal island produce, building generous, deeply savoury dishes that bring regional Tamil cooking to the table.
specialtyDescription: Aromatic roasted masalas and fresh northern-coast seafood

dishes.label: NORTHERN COAST
dishes.name: Jaffna Crab Curry
dishes.description: Fresh crab simmered in roasted Jaffna spices, coconut, and fragrant curry leaves.

dishes.label: FAMILY RECIPE
dishes.name: Northern Mutton Kulambu
dishes.description: Slow-cooked mutton in a deep, aromatic masala with a gentle coconut finish.

dishes.label: HEARTH GRAINS
dishes.name: Curry Leaf Ghee Rice
dishes.description: Fragrant rice toasted in ghee with cashews, curry leaves, and warm spices.

quote: A good spice blend does not hide an ingredient. It gives every flavour a place at the table.

name: Malik Fernando
title: Grill & Ember Master
venue: The Open Ember Hearth, Galle Fort
biography: Malik works by instinct and by the fire. He builds each ember bed for the ingredient at hand, bringing a measured smokiness and a beautiful char to the hearth's grilled dishes.
His approach starts with the island's catch and seasonal produce, finished with bright marinades, hand-ground spices, and a close eye on the changing heat.
specialtyDescription: Ember-grilled seafood and produce with island spice marinades

dishes.label: OPEN EMBER
dishes.name: Cinnamon-Fire Lagoon Prawns
dishes.description: Charred prawns brushed with lime, island pepper, and a cinnamon-smoke butter.

dishes.imageAlt: A bowl of smoky roasted vegetables
dishes.label: GARDEN EMBERS
dishes.name: Ember-Roasted Garden Harvest
dishes.description: Seasonal island vegetables grilled over coals with a toasted spice dressing.

dishes.label: SMOKE & GRAIN
dishes.name: Smoked Coconut Rice
dishes.description: Coconut rice finished over the embers with herbs and crisp shallots.

quote: The fire is never the same twice. You learn to read it, then let the ingredients speak.

name: Kasun Rathnayake
title: Pastry Chef & Keeper of Sweet Traditions
biography: Kasun's pastry brings the warmth of Sri Lankan sweets into a modern dining experience. He draws on familiar ingredients such as jaggery, coconut, treacle, and seasonal fruit.
Patient technique and a light touch guide his work, from gently spiced baked treats to carefully composed desserts made for the end of a hearth-side meal.
specialtyDescription: Jaggery, coconut, and seasonal island fruit

dishes.label: SWEET HEARTH
dishes.name: Warm Jaggery & Coconut Pudding
dishes.description: A gently spiced coconut pudding finished with rich island kithul treacle.

dishes.label: SEASONAL FRUIT
dishes.name: Cinnamon-Baked Island Fruit
dishes.description: Seasonal fruit baked with cinnamon and served with coconut cream.

dishes.label: AFTER THE EMBERS
dishes.name: Coconut & Cardamom Shortbread
dishes.description: Buttery shortbread with toasted coconut and fragrant cardamom.

quote: The sweetest memories often begin with the simplest island ingredients.

name: Nimal Perera
title: Spice Sommelier & Keeper of the Island Pantry
biography: Nimal explores Sri Lanka through its spices, from the bright heat of black pepper to the deep fragrance of toasted cinnamon. He selects and blends each spice to complement the ingredients around it.
Working closely with growers and the kitchen team, he celebrates regional spice traditions and helps guests discover the small details that make each dish distinct.
specialtyDescription: Small-batch spice blends sourced from island growers

dishes.imageAlt: A dish seasoned with island spices
dishes.label: SPICE ROUTE
dishes.name: Cinnamon & Pepper Braised Chicken
dishes.description: Tender chicken braised with Ceylon cinnamon, black pepper, and toasted aromatics.

dishes.imageAlt: A curry made with fragrant spice
dishes.label: MATALE HARVEST

dishes.label: AROMATIC GRAIN
dishes.name: Cardamom & Curry Leaf Rice
dishes.description: Fragrant rice with toasted cardamom, curry leaves, and cashews.

quote: Every spice has a story of place, weather, and hands. A blend is how we let those stories meet.
